body_html:
#smallpeoms
Tell tales....
Specters of time
Past, present, future
But spirit we fear most
one who rips into
your soul...
Ghost of Christmas Never Was
robbing past and present.
Yet spirit and hope
bring that which always is
defeating that which never was
#WeLoveYouBabyBobby
